component.name: OpenCode Desktop
component.summary: A desktop GUI wrapper for OpenCode

description.p: OpenCode Desktop provides a modern graphical interface for OpenCode, the AI-powered coding assistant. Browse existing sessions, create new conversations with image attachments, and manage your projects — all from a native Linux desktop application.

ul.li: Browse and search OpenCode session history
Create new sessions with image paste (Ctrl+V) and drag-and-drop
Project folder management with create/select support
Tool call visualization with expandable details
